BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to master application fees; and amending RCW19.02.075.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.02.075 and 1995 c 403 s 1007 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (((1))) The department shall collect a handling fee ((of fifteendollars)) on each master application((. The entire master applicationfee shall be deposited in the master license fund. (2) The department shall collect a fee of nine dollars on)) andeach renewal application filing. ((Renewal application fees shall))The department shall set the amount of the handling fees by rule, asauthorized by RCW 19.02.030. The handling fees may not exceed nineteendollars for each master application, and eleven dollars for eachrenewal application filing, and must be deposited in the master licensefund.
